facts.fact: The Bank of Tanzania, which trialled TIPS with three banks and two telecoms, rolled the instant payment system out to the whole financial sector, with 39 banks and six telecoms integrated by end-January 2024, the governor says.

TZA.note: Document states no consumer-protection rule or complaints body.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Only a plan to link TIPS to eGePG for government payments; no payment to people stated.
Financial inclusion of 76 per cent is not stated as a survey share of adults with an account.

facts.fact: TIPS enables instant transfers and payments between bank accounts and mobile wallets, with 39 banks and six telecoms integrated by end-January 2024, the BoT governor says.
The Bank of Tanzania rolled TIPS out to the entire financial sector, a single connection for banks and telecoms facilitating P2P, P2B and P2M transfers.

TZA.note: Only a plan to integrate TIPS with eGePG; no revenue payment stated.
